mapper.sql: id, plan_no, batch_no, product_date, type, product_id, product_name, product_merge_code, product_specification, inner_packing_specification, packing_specification, process_id, process_name, process_num, process_version, status, instruct_status, is_relation, process_instance_id, is_start, start_time, end_time, execute_process_instance_id, confirm_time, batch_quantity, unit_id, execute_paused, production_line_id, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, is_deleted, archive_status, modify_count
mapper.select:
select t1.id from bm_product_plan t1 where t1.is_deleted = 0
and t1.plan_no like concat('%',#{planNo},'%')
and t1.batch_no like concat('%',#{batchNo},'%')
and t1.process_name like concat('%',#{processName},'%')
and t1.product_name like concat('%',#{productName},'%')
and t1.type = #{type}

select bm_process_version.product_formula_version_id from bm_product_plan left join bm_process_version on bm_product_plan.process_id = bm_process_version.process_id and bm_product_plan.process_version = bm_process_version.version where bm_product_plan.id = #{productPlanId}

select * from bm_product_plan where is_deleted = 0 and concat(process_id, '-', batch_no) in
#{fullBatchNo}

select t1.id, t1.plan_no, t1.batch_no, t1.product_id, t1.product_date, t1.type, t1.product_name, t1.product_merge_code, t1.product_specification, t1.process_id, t1.process_name, t1.process_version, t1.production_line_id from bm_product_plan t1 where t1.instruct_status = 'SEND' and t1.status = 'CONFIRM' and t1.is_start = 'WAIT'
and t1.product_date > NOW()
and t1.product_date <= NOW()
and t1.process_id in
#{processId}
and t1.batch_no like concat('%',#{batchNo},'%')
and t1.product_id in
#{productId}
and t1.production_line_id in
#{lineId}
ORDER BY t1.product_date asc
